== Source, printing and text-state verification (Story 386) ==
The [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-world-championship-top-8-dennis-reinhardt-ds-invasion/ published Players Committee decklist] was compared with the [[Media:26Worlds T8 Reinhardt DS Invasion.txt|wiki-hosted XML download]] and the card articles linked in the table. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114024634/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2026-world-championship-top-8-dennis-reinhardt-ds-invasion.html Players Committee decklist]. The download's File page attributes the XML to the forum distribution; the original forum ZIP has not been independently byte-verified.
The download contains 60 constructed-card entries. Its SHA-256 is <code>c3c97ed1ed9a273eac9febbc01aedf37ba3035f3dc360e9b878ad13c407d6d49</code>; the download bytes were retained. The article lists 60 constructed cards and 28 outside-deck cards. Each outside-deck XML identity is counted separately; a card outside the deck is placed in its own card-type group when it is not a Defensive Shield.

=== Printing choices ===
* 2x [[B2 Battle Droid (ALT) (Errata)]]: XML <nowiki>204_36^</nowiki>. The explicit XML image variant is represented by the existing ALT article and its matching published image.
* 2x [[Lord Sidious (ALT) (Errata)]]: XML <nowiki>208_35^</nowiki>. The explicit XML image variant is represented by the existing ALT article and its matching published image.
* 1x [[Coarse And Rough And Irritating (ALT) (Errata)]]: XML <nowiki>200_109^</nowiki>. The explicit XML image variant is represented by the existing ALT article and its matching published image.

=== Wording in the import reference ===
These links use the existing article with the requested card identity. The engine reference associated with the XML code and that article have the following wording differences; neither the card article nor the download was rewritten to erase them.
* [[Self-Destruct Mechanism (PC Errata)]] (<nowiki>3_134</nowiki>, gameText): engine reference <nowiki>Lose a droid to cancel all attrition against you at same site this turn. OR Re-target an opponent's weapon to one of your droids at same site as target. If droid is 'hit', use original target's forfeit number.</nowiki>; card article <nowiki>Lose a droid to cancel all attrition against you at same site this turn. OR Retarget an opponent's weapon to one of your droids at same site as target. If droid is 'hit', use original target's forfeit number.</nowiki>.
